This package-level version bump is for npm-publish-readiness purposes only; it does not itself bump the AlphaClaw feature/* branch (which stays under the standing never-touch-the-AlphaClaw-repo constraint) -- that branch's own version can follow and catch up separately later, as a distinct, future action.
